description: This file is a shell script containing tests for Git checkout functionality, including various scenarios such as branch switching, creating new branches, handling unmergeable changes, and failure cases.

methods.name: do_checkout
methods.description: Performs a git checkout with various options, verifying expected state and handling failure scenarios.

methods.name: test_dirty_unmergeable
methods.description: Checks for unmergeable changes in the working directory.

methods.name: test_dirty_unmergeable_discards_changes
methods.description: Verifies that unmergeable changes are discarded when appropriate.

methods.name: setup_dirty_unmergeable
methods.description: Sets up the working directory with unmergeable changes for testing.

methods.name: test_dirty_mergeable
methods.description: Checks for mergeable changes in the staging area.

methods.name: test_dirty_mergeable_discards_changes
methods.description: Verifies that mergeable changes are discarded when using checkout options.

methods.name: setup_dirty_mergeable
methods.description: Sets up the working directory with mergeable changes for testing.
